21. On perusal of the record it appears that the occurrence alleged to have taken place on 31.12.1992 at 10.00 a.m. It further appears that the Senior Assistant Judge, Jamalpur imposed an order of status-quo upon the parties on 18.7.1992 in Title Suit No.71 of 1992. From the plaint of the aforesaid case, it appears that informant Mala Rauth instituted the O.C. Suit No.71 of 1992 against the convict-petitioner and others alleging acquisition of .13 acres of land out of .27 acres appertaining from CS Khatian No. 1522 and 1523 with definite land specification. There is no evidence on record that the aforesaid status-quo order has been ever vacated till or before the date of occurrence. 

 "Defence that the entry into the disputed but was bonafide basing its claim on CS Khatian and registered sale deed such defence is untenable when Civil Court found the title in favour of the complainant coupled with possession."
